verdict.rationale: Yapily's own docs describe a Webhook API that sends real-time HTTP notifications of platform changes. Users register their own HTTPS endpoint and can subscribe to multiple event categories within a single webhook, with payment-status events called out explicitly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented event catalog and delivery/signature-verification details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allows you to receive real-time HTTP notifications of changes happening in the Yapily Platform.
Create an endpoint on a secure server that can process HTTPS requests.
the ability to subscribe to multiple event categories within a single webhook
They provide real-time HTTP notifications when a payment completes successfully or fails
